title: All 112 data_anomalies rows are NEGATIVE edges; longshot ML sides are hidden as "bad data", leaving one-sided moneylines
steps: Load data_anomalies: 112 rows, edge_pct < 0 for all 112, none positive
Example id 94: cfb-6cbe20aab84d37ab (UCLA v Illinois) ml:away betmgm 7.0 vs fair 9.36, edge -25.2%, books=5. Snapshot has mybookieag 9.25 (non-bettable) pulling consensus
market_prices: 24 of 298 events have only ONE moneyline side stored; all 24 have an anomaly for the other side
expected: The sanity cap catches implausible (stale or mis-mapped) edges; a book simply offering a short price on an underdog is not corrupt data.
actual: Negative |edge| > 25% on high-vig longshots is logged as an anomaly and the whole side is removed from the board. 39 anomalies have books=1 (fair price from a single book). No positive >25% anomaly exists in the data, so the check is untested on its intended case.
